githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.7 Beta 3 adds group DM editing and leaving, separate message styles for DMs, groups, and servers, and quick messages from profile cards. It also introduces animated typing bubbles and improves unread tracking, search navigation, and member loading.

## Message appearance and motion

- Added separate Default and Bubbles message styles for direct messages, group DMs, and servers.
- Added animated typing bubbles with participant avatars when using the Bubbles message style.
- Improved attachment previews, composer resizing, and message sending transitions, with support for Reduce Motion and a new option to disable message sending animations in both Default and Bubbles styles.

## Group DMs and profiles

- Added Edit Group controls to rename group DMs and change or remove their icons.
- Added Leave Group with an option to leave without notifying other members.
- Added quick messages from profile cards, opening the DM after a successful send, and clickable avatars that open the full profile.
- Added private-profile notices and improved profile switching and resizing as content loads.

## Messaging tools and fixes

- Improved reply controls with an @ indicator and a remembered ping preference shared across conversations and app restarts.
- Added Shift shortcuts in the message hover toolbar for copying message IDs and links, marking messages unread, and pinning where permitted.
- Fixed dictionary Look Up through Force Click and the message context menu.
- Fixed duplicate or incorrectly ordered messages from overlapping history loads, including a related crash when loading reactions.

## Search and unread tracking

- Improved search navigation by retaining searches separately for each server and for DMs, restoring them when returning to that scope, and keeping results available when opening matching messages.
- Fixed long unread backlogs remaining unread after scrolling to the newest message, while preserving unread status when opening directly at an unseen backlog's tail.
- Fixed server unread dots and Dock unread-conversation counts including archived, left, or inaccessible threads, and corrected forum indicators to reflect unseen posts.
- Fixed failed read-state updates discarding messages or mentions that arrived while the update was pending.

## Servers and reliability

- Fixed member lists getting stuck on loading placeholders after refreshes or reconnects, and preserved the visible member range when a connection resumes.
- Fixed forum channels disappearing from the sidebar when Discord returned unexpected forum metadata, and server icons staying blank after failed image loads.
- Improved sidebar selection, unread markers, member-list spacing, and long server-name tooltips.
- Reduced repeated rendering work in member lists and animated images, and stopped unnecessary slowmode countdown updates after expiry.
- Fixed ordinary Discord request errors interrupting unrelated account activity.

## Build switching

- Added a native warning before installing a pull-request build, explaining the risks of running contributor code.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.7-Beta-2...v0.1.7-Beta-3](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.7-Beta-2...v0.1.7-Beta-3)
discordAnnouncement:
**Group DM controls, message styles, and typing bubbles 🌙**

**Highlights**
- Rename group DMs, change their icons, or leave with an option to avoid notifying other members.
- Choose Default or Bubbles separately for DMs, groups, and servers, with animated typing bubbles in Bubbles mode.
- Send a quick message from a profile card and jump into the DM after sending.
- Keep your reply ping choice across restarts, and hold Shift over a message for more toolbar actions.
- Return to saved searches for each server or your DMs, with improved unread tracking and Dock counts.
- Get fixes for stuck member lists, missing forum channels, blank server icons, and duplicate timeline messages.
